interpretation: The available five complete index sources have no license or copyright declarations; that observation does not establish license absence in upstream or in the binary files.
Assistant has no entry in the supplied index receipt; this is not evidence that an upstream index or license does not exist.

Checksums and Git blob IDs establish matching source-byte identities against supplied receipts, not ownership, grant, transformation history, runtime shipping or rights. No internal font table was decoded and no font format parser was executed.

The Excalidraw root MIT notice is not applied to the font binaries. MIT compatibility, SPDX, attribution, reserved names and obligations remain undetermined until authoritative terms tied to these exact versions are obtained.

If authoritative grants establish conditions, review those exact conditions and compatibility with the intended MIT project distribution, preserve required notices, and satisfy applicable modification, reserved-name and distribution terms before adoption. This conditional instruction is not a finding that any particular font license applies.
